findings.claim: Row r4's fails_when is wider than the outcome it checks. The outcome says files in other codebases and runtime paths 'stay as they are', but r4 flags any backticked token whose basename matches a tracked file. docs/reference/registry-ui.md:52 names `embark.json`, the ModelKit layer that is embark's own serving config (see deployments/applications/services/registry-ui/backend/src/registry_ui/registry.py:12). r4 matches it to deployments/infrastructure/services/grafana/embark.json, an unrelated Grafana dashboard. As signed, r4 can only pass if the builder points the page at the wrong file or strips the backticks to dodge the regex. Either way the contract contradicts the outcome's carve-out. The command does assert its fails_when exactly; the fails_when is what needs fixing. Narrow it, for example with an explicit allow-list of tokens the audit classes as other-codebase or runtime (starting with registry-ui's `embark.json`), or let a token count as resolved when the page qualifies it as a non-repo file.

r4 flagged registry-ui's `embark.json`, a file in another codebase, against an unrelated tracked Grafana dashboard. r4 now has ALLOW={"embark.json"}, and its fails_when and the outcome name the allow-list. Run on the current tree, r4 no longer reports embark.json.

cli-login.md now documents that login writes the Vault token to ~/.vault-token, but its sources omit cli/src/localstack_cli/auth/vault_token_file.py, the code that does it, so kmctl review due will not flag the page when that file changes.

The secrets.tf row in vault-human-auth.md reads as the file's full list of human-auth KV writes (operator, OpenViking consumers, smoke client), but secrets.tf also writes the OIDC client secrets for oauth2-proxy, its registry-ui copy, grafana and ov-dash. Either name those or say the row lists only the human credentials.

Several prose lines added in this change run past 80 characters, against check 1 of slop-scan-for-docs.md. Examples are the repo-root path rewrites in gcs-backups.md (lines 26, 53-58, 62, 86), monitoring.md:66, edge-routes.md:43, registry-ui.md:102 and the Server bullet in nats.md:16. Rewrap them.
